full_prompt_en: The image is a square, delicately textured nocturnal illustration of a small church above a curving moonlit shore framed by tall wildflowers. A muted slate-blue sky fills the upper half, sprinkled with countless tiny cream and gold points and one round pale moon near the upper center. On the left rise dark blue and olive tree masses with thin pale trunks and fine bare twigs. A small cream church sits among them on a low bank, its narrow tower pointing upward and a few dark arched windows visible in the walls. Its pale surfaces catch faint light but remain subdued within the surrounding trees. The shoreline begins below the church and sweeps in a bright curved strip toward the middle right, separating tawny land from dark teal water. Thin pale wave marks follow this curve and gradually fade into calmer water at the far right. Across the entire lower third, a dense stand of wildflowers and stems rises in front of the view. Tall white umbrella-shaped seed heads appear at left and lower center, while smaller white clusters, mustard-yellow blossoms, and deep blue flower heads scatter between slender gray-green stalks. The flowers partly veil the beach and the near water, creating a layered foreground that feels both fine and abundant. The night light is soft and diffuse from the small moon and pale sky; it turns the shoreline and flower tips silver-white while leaving the water and trees a deeper blue-green. Tiny speckles continue through the vegetation and air, as if light and grain share the same painted surface. Edges stay delicate, with crisp little stalks and church contours set inside softer tonal masses. The viewpoint sits close to the flowered bank and looks across the sweeping shore, allowing a small built focal point to rest under a generous sky. The overall composition uses a luminous curved shoreline, dark blue water, quiet architecture, and many pinprick highlights to create a hushed dreamlike night.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、纹理细致的夜景插画，一座小教堂立在弯曲的月光海岸上方，高高的野花围住前景。低饱和板岩蓝天空占据上半部，撒满无数奶油色与金色小光点，中央偏上有一轮浅色圆月。左侧升起深蓝与橄榄色树团，细浅色树干和纤细光枝穿插其间。低岸上的小教堂藏在树中，窄塔向上指，墙面可见几扇深色拱窗。浅色表面承接微光，却仍在周围树木中显得克制。海岸线从教堂下方开始，以一道明亮弧形伸向中央偏右，将褐黄色土地与深青色水面分开。细浅色浪痕顺着弧线排列，向最右边更平静的水面逐渐消退。整个下方三分之一升起一片密集野花和草茎，挡在视野前。高高的白色伞形籽头出现在左侧和下方中央，较小的白花簇、芥末黄花和深蓝花头散在纤细灰绿茎之间。花朵部分遮住沙滩和近水，使前景既细密又丰沛。夜光从小月亮和浅色天空柔和漫射，把海岸线和花梢染成银白，水和树仍是更深的蓝绿。细小斑点遍布植被与空气，仿佛亮光与颗粒共享同一绘画表面。边缘保持精巧，清晰的小茎与教堂轮廓嵌在更柔的调子里。视点贴近开花的岸坡，望过弯曲海岸，让小小建筑焦点安放在宽裕天空下。整体构图以发亮的弧形海岸、深蓝水面、安静建筑和许多针尖高光，形成轻声细语般的梦境夜色。
style_prompt_en: Delicate illustration builds a dusk-blue surface from soft matte masses and innumerable tiny light specks. Slate, teal, olive, and muted tan occupy the large areas, while cream, silver-white, and sparse warm gold make small concentrated accents. Fine upright strokes accumulate densely along the lower edge; a broad bright curve cuts through the middle and opens the composition toward a darker quiet zone. Contours stay thin and selective, with compact detailed forms nested inside hazier surrounding fields. A small high light source and diffuse atmosphere create gentle silvery edges rather than hard shadows. Grain-like dots continue across near and far layers, unifying them without flattening the spacing. The overall effect is hushed, intricate, and luminous within a restrained cool palette.
style_prompt_zh: 精巧插画以柔和哑光大形和无数细小亮点搭成暮蓝色表面。板岩蓝、青绿、橄榄与低饱和褐色占据大面积，奶油色、银白与稀少暖金色形成细小集中强调。纤细竖笔在下缘密集累积，一道宽亮曲线切过中部，把构图打开到较暗较静的区域。轮廓细而有选择，紧凑的详细形体嵌在周围更朦胧的色域中。一处高位小光源与漫射空气制造温柔银边，而非坚硬阴影。颗粒般小点延续在远近层里，将它们统一却不压平层距。整体效果安静、繁密，在克制冷配色中发亮。
theme_en: A small church above a curving moonlit shore framed by tall wildflowers
theme_zh: 月光海岸弯曲，一座小教堂立于其上，前景高野花环绕
name: Lucy Grossmith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
